signatures.description: Implement a Flexible Paxos replica: phase-1 quorum Q1 and phase-2 quorum Q2 are configured independently and safety holds only if every Q1 intersects every Q2 (|Q1|+|Q2| > N), so a fixed full-majority check is simultaneously unsound for some configs and needlessly rejecting for others. Build the acceptor state machine (promised ballot, accepted ballot/value, recovery ballot) plus a proposer that recovers a possibly-committed value after a crash using only Q1 responses, tolerating stale and reordered messages, ballot/lease conflicts, and two proposers with interleaved ballots that each believe they hold a Q2 majority. Ship a deterministic message-reorder harness proving no two proposers commit different values at the same log index for any legal quorum configuration, and make the config loader reject any Q1+Q2 <= N.
